We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: SBP Sales Supervisor

Job Locations: Agbara Badagry, Ajegunle, Alimosho, Ikeja, Ikorodu, Ipaja Ayobo, Lekki Ajah, Mushin, Oshodi, Sango- Lagos

	Drive sales across priority Lush Hair SKUs and ensure appropriate product mix.

	Maintain strong relationships with existing SBPs.
	Identify and onboard qualified new SBPs in strategic locations across(Priority).

	Ensure effective execution of SBP promotions, campaigns and activations.
